parameters.query:
SELECT q.request_id, q.engagement_id, q.rule_id, q.request_reason, q.created_at,
       l.file_name, l.source_path
FROM audit_core.pbc_request_queue q
LEFT JOIN audit_core.pbc_tieout_result t ON t.tieout_id = q.tieout_id
LEFT JOIN audit_core.stg_ingestion_log l ON l.batch_id = t.left_batch_id
WHERE q.status = 'OPEN'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_core.pbc_notification_log n
                  WHERE n.request_id = q.request_id AND n.channel = 'EMAIL')
ORDER BY q.created_at;
